items.docs: The Delete Conversation API allows users to remove a conversation from a specific project using its unique project ID. This endpoint permanently deletes the conversation and its associated messages, ensuring that project discussions can be managed and maintained according to organizational policies. Upon successful deletion, the API returns an HTTP 204 No Content response, indicating that the conversation has been successfully removed without returning a response body.

If the page size is insufficient to accommodate the whole number of responses obtained, the pagination object will include a link to the next page as well as the next page token. If left blank, it defaults to 100.

items.docs: The Create Conversation API allows users to initiate a new conversation within a specified project using its unique project ID. This endpoint facilitates seamless communication by enabling teams to start discussions, share updates, and collaborate effectively within the project workspace. Upon a successful request, the API returns the newly created conversation details, including metadata such as participants, timestamps, and initial message content.
